content.title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' First Look At Trailer: Tom Holland & Fans Tease Superhero Movie Releasing Short Clips
content.text: Tom Holland Sony / Marvel Tom Holland is swinging back into theaters this summer as the web-slinger in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, teasing the trailer by celebrating fans. Ahead of the release of the full trailer for the Sony Pictures movie, snippets of the preview have dropped across social media, giving a first look at the superhero film. “We have had so much love and support since day dot of making these movies, and without that incredible community, there would be no Spider-Man,” Holland said in a post on Instagram. RELATED: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Cast Photos: All The Actors Confirmed For Marvel Movie He continued, “To show you our appreciation, we are doing something that has never been done before. Follow along as a brand new day starts across the world, and some of our greatest fans are going to help us release pieces of our new trailer.” The full trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day will drop on Wednesday, March 18, but fans have already unveiled clips, which you can see below. RELATED: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Wraps Filming, Director Destin Daniel Cretton Calls It His “Most Rewarding Film” RELATED: Tom Holland Begins Filming ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ In Glasgow: “Feels Different This Time” Spider-Man: Brand New Day is set to release on July 31, 2026. The film, directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, stars Holland, who reprises his role as Peter Parker. Zendaya also returns as MJ, with Sadie Sink and Liza Colón-Zayas also joining the cast in undisclosed roles. Scroll through the photo stills below to get a first look at Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
